title: China Culinary Map
synopsis: Follow the culinary map across China and taste some popular delicacies from around the country: squirrel fish, xiaolongbao, dim sum, and roujiamo. This journey will be a feast for your taste buds.

fullText.simplified:
中国美食地图

    很多人都知道中国是一个美食大国，有很多有名的菜。那你知道在中国人眼里，什么菜才是美食吗？中国人觉得美食要又好看又好吃，下面这些菜是中国人眼里的美食。
    松鼠鱼。松鼠鱼是江苏菜，看起来像一只松鼠，但其实是用鱼做的。这道菜吃起来是甜的，鱼肉很脆。
    小笼包。小笼包是上海菜，是一种小包子。上海人喜欢在早上吃小笼包。起床以后，吃几个热热的小笼包，一天都是高兴的。但是吃小笼包的时候最好慢一点，因为小笼包里有肉汤，有点儿热。
    点心。点心是广东人喜欢吃的美食。广东人喜欢在上午去茶楼吃早茶，主要就是吃点心和喝茶。广东人的点心有甜的，也有咸的。有的点心里有水果，有的点心里有肉，但都长得非常好看。
    肉夹馍。肉夹馍是陕西人常吃的美食，跟Taco差不多。陕西人把猪肉和绿色的菜放在饼里，虽然看起来不那么好看，但是吃起来很香。肉夹馍用的饼有的软，有的硬，但是里面的猪肉都很软。饿的时候，吃一个肉夹馍，是一件让人非常高兴的事情。
    煎饼。中国很多地方都有煎饼，但是天津的煎饼最有名。天津人非常爱吃煎饼，一个星期有三天早饭都要吃煎饼。天津人把鸡蛋、绿色的菜和芝麻放在煎饼里，面的香、鸡蛋的香、菜的香在一起，吃起来又热又软，很多外国人都喜欢吃天津煎饼。
    这些中国菜是中国人喜欢的美食，也是很多外国人喜欢的美食。如果你还没吃过，可以去试试。
fullText.traditional:
中國美食地圖

    很多人都知道中國是一個美食大國，有很多有名的菜。那你知道在中國人眼裡，什麼菜才是美食嗎？中國人覺得美食要又好看又好吃，下面這些菜是中國人眼裡的美食。
    松鼠魚。松鼠魚是江蘇菜，看起來像一隻松鼠，但其實是用魚做的。這道菜吃起來是甜的，魚肉很脆。
    小籠包。小籠包是上海菜，是一種小包子。上海人喜歡在早上吃小籠包。起床以後，吃幾個熱熱的小籠包，一天都是高興的。但是吃小籠包的時候最好慢一點，因為小籠包裡有肉湯，有點兒熱。
    點心。點心是廣東人喜歡吃的美食。廣東人喜歡在上午去茶樓吃早茶，主要就是吃點心和喝茶。廣東人的點心有甜的，也有鹹的。有的點心裡有水果，有的點心裡有肉，但都長得非常好看。
    肉夾饃。肉夾饃是陝西人常吃的美食，跟Taco差不多。陝西人把豬肉和綠色的菜放在餅裡，雖然看起來不那麼好看，但是吃起來很香。肉夾饃用的餅有的軟，有的硬，但是裡面的豬肉都很軟。餓的時候，吃一個肉夾饃，是一件讓人非常高興的事情。
    煎餅。中國很多地方都有煎餅，但是天津的煎餅最有名。天津人非常愛吃煎餅，一個星期有三天早飯都要吃煎餅。天津人把雞蛋、綠色的菜和芝麻放在煎餅裡，麵的香、雞蛋的香、菜的香在一起，吃起來又熱又軟，很多外國人都喜歡吃天津煎餅。
    這些中國菜是中國人喜歡的美食，也是很多外國人喜歡的美食。如果你還沒吃過，可以去試試。

This dish tastes sweet, and the fish is very crispy.

But, it’s best to eat xiaolongbao slowly because there is broth inside the xiaolongbao that makes them quite hot.

sentences.traditional: 有的點心裡有水果，有的點心裡有肉，但都長得非常好看。

sentences.english: Some Cantonese dim sum are sweet, and some are savory.
Some dim sum have fruit inside, and some have meat inside, but they all look very pretty.

sentences.traditional: 陝西人把豬肉和綠色的菜放在餅裡，雖然看起來不那麼好看，但是吃起來很香。

sentences.english: Roujiamo. Roujiamo is a culinary delicacy often eaten by people from Shaanxi. It is similar to a taco.

sentences.simplified: 饿的时候，吃一个肉夹馍，是一件让人非常高兴的事情。
sentences.traditional: 餓的時候，吃一個肉夾饃，是一件讓人非常高興的事情。

When you are hungry, eating a roujiamo is something that can make you very happy.

sentences.english: People from Tianjin love eating jianbing. They eat jianbing for breakfast three days out of the week.

sentences.simplified: 面的香、鸡蛋的香、菜的香在一起，吃起来又热又软，

sentences.traditional: 很多外國人都喜歡吃天津煎餅。

Many foreigners love Tianjin jianbing.

sentences.english: These Chinese dishes are culinary delicacies enjoyed by Chinese people as well as many foreigners.

sentence_translations: China Culinary Map
Many people know that China is a great culinary nation with many famous dishes.
Then do you know what dishes are considered culinary delicacies by Chinese people?
Chinese people believe that culinary delicacies must both look good and taste good.
The following dishes are considered culinary delicacies by Chinese people.
Squirrel fish. Squirrel fish is a dish from Jiangsu. It looks like a squirrel but is actually made of fish.
This dish tastes sweet, and the fish is very crispy.
Xiaolongbao. Xiaolongbao are from Shanghai. They are a type of small bun.
People from Shanghai like to eat Xiaolongbao in the morning.
After getting up and eating several hot xiaolongbao, you’ll be happy all day.
But, it’s best to eat xiaolongbao slowly because there is broth inside the xiaolongbao that makes them quite hot.
Dim sum. Dim sum are culinary delicacies enjoyed by Cantonese people.
Cantonese people like to go to dim sum restaurants to have dim sum, which mainly consists of eating dim sum and drinking tea.
Some Cantonese dim sum are sweet, and some are savory.
Some dim sum have fruit inside, and some have meat inside, but they all look very pretty.
Roujiamo. Roujiamo is a culinary delicacy often eaten by people from Shaanxi. It is similar to a taco.
People from Shaanxi put pork and green vegetables inside a bun. Even though it doesn’t look that pretty, it tastes delicious.
Some roujiamo buns are soft, and some are hard, but the pork inside is always very soft.
When you are hungry, eating a roujiamo is something that can make you very happy.
Jianbing. Many places in China have jianbing, but the jianbing from Tianjin is the most famous.
People from Tianjin love eating jianbing. They eat jianbing for breakfast three days out of the week.
People from Tianjin put egg, green vegetables, and sesame seeds in the jianbing.
The aroma of the dough, the egg, and the vegetables come together, and it is warm and soft to eat.
Many foreigners love Tianjin jianbing.
These Chinese dishes are culinary delicacies enjoyed by Chinese people as well as many foreigners.
If you haven’t eaten them before, go ahead and try them.
